# Fraunces Variable Font (`assets/vendor/fonts/fraunces/`)

Self-hosted variable serif display typeface for OKO headings and eyebrows (`--font-serif`).

## Usage Note

- **Variable font axes used:** `wght` (`100..900`), `opsz` (`9..144`), `SOFT` (`0..100`), `WONK` (`0..1`).
- Loaded via `@font-face` in `/assets/css/polish.css` with `font-display: swap`.
- Used for display `<h1>`/`<h2>` headings, italic `<em>` accents (`receipt`), and section eyebrows.
